summary: CR-385 New Booking v2.18 + cross-tab row-toggle fix fully verified on /cr385-frontdesk-mockup.html (viewport 1920x800). All v2.18 deltas pass: (1) new Room×Rate-plan GRID (data-testid=booking-rate-grid) renders 3 rows × 4 columns with the exact all-in per-night prices — Deluxe 2200/2500/2900/3200, Executive 3300/3600/4000/4300, Suite 4500/4800/5200/5500; default cell booking-cell-deluxe-ep carries 'nb-cell on' style; old testids booking-room-types, booking-meal-plans and booking-billing-section confirmed absent. (2) Clicking booking-cell-executive-map switches BOTH type + plan: booking-progress-type = '✓ Executive', RIGHT bill shows booking-room-charge ₹3,300, booking-meal-charge ₹700, SGST ₹55/CGST ₹55 kept SEPARATE, booking-total ₹4,200 = (3300+700)*1*1.05. booking-cell-suite-ep hides the meal-charge line (count=0) and shows room 4500. (3) Extending check-out by 2 days (3 nights) on Suite-EP correctly gives room ₹13,500 and total ₹14,175. (4) B2B moved into booking-guest-section (JS ancestor check confirmed), placeholder '15-digit GSTIN' present, Save/Check-In disabled until both GST fields filled. (5) Readiness gating unchanged (buttons disabled until name+10-digit phone). CRM phone 9811122233 shows booking-returning-guest and autofills name 'R. Fernandes'. (6) Advance toggle reveals booking-advance-fields; no-scroll invariant holds: collapsed sh=157/ch=157/btnBottom=505, expanded+filled Cash sh=340/ch=340/btnBottom=688 (all <= 800). (7) NEW — advance carries into Check-In: entering Advance now=1000+Cash then Save & Check in now morphs to checkin-expansion with checkin-already-paid=₹1,000 and checkin-balance-before=₹1,310 (=2310-1000). (8) Save booking closes the form, activates Arrivals tab and inserts a new BK-4022 row with 'unassigned' room. (9) CROSS-TAB ROW TOGGLE FIX verified on all four tabs — arrivals row expand→re-click collapses (open_row=0); departures row expand→collapse; in-house row expand→collapse; rooms tile expand→collapse; and switching to a DIFFERENT row still swaps the open row in a single click (open_total remained =1). Row action buttons still work with stopPropagation: 'Check In' on arrivals opens checkin-expansion, 'Bill' on departures opens bill-expansion, Esc closes. Regressions unchanged: ?bill=103 grand ₹2,677, ?bill=107 grand ₹0, ?checkin=a2 has SGST/CGST separate + room-picker + confirm button. 1024w grid remains visible. ZERO JS console/page errors across the entire flow.
critical_code_review_comments: cr385-frontdesk-mockup.html is now 717 lines with growing inline JS; still fine for a mockup but the LOC keeps climbing across CRs — consider a follow-up split when this graduates from mockup.

nbGrid disables an entire type row when avail===0 for that type. That is only correct for EP-style single-room bookings; a fully sold-out Executive type will grey out all four Executive rate plans, hiding the fact that a rate plan (not availability) is the differentiator. Non-blocking for the demo but worth clarifying with product before backend wire-up.
